_help: Visual Dodge settings. ReactionSeconds: how many seconds before an enemy attack reaches Wukong the staff glows; set it to your reaction time (0 = when the perfect dodge window opens). FlashSeconds: length of the glow (0 = 0.25 s). Clip: the game's display clip that makes Wukong glow, a path in Wukong's clip folder (/Game/00Main/VFX/Characters/sunwukong/DBC/) or a full /Game/ path. Changes apply at the next game start.
